title: Renting my first flat
text:
When I moved to a new city for work, I needed a flat fast. I found a nice one online: one bedroom, a balcony, and a good price. The photos looked great, so I wrote to the owner immediately.

We met on Saturday. The flat was clean, but I noticed a few problems. The kitchen tap was leaking, and one window did not close properly. The owner promised to repair everything before I moved in. I asked him to put this promise in the contract, and he agreed.

Then we talked about money. Besides the rent, I had to pay a deposit, which is a sum you give to the owner at the start and get back when you leave. It was equal to one month's rent. I also asked who pays for the heating, because in winter it can be expensive.

I signed the contract on Monday. Two weeks later, the tap was fixed, but the window was still the same. I sent the owner a polite message with a photo. He came the next day. It is a small lesson: always write down what people promise.

questions.prompt: Why did the author ask the owner to put the promise in the contract?
options: He wanted the repairs to be official.
He did not like the owner.
questions.explanation: Записана в договорі обіцянка надійніша, ніж усна.

questions.prompt: What is a deposit in this text?
options: Money you give at the start and can get back later
questions.explanation: У тексті пояснюється: це сума, яку віддають на початку й повертають, коли виїжджаєш.

questions.prompt: What lesson did the author learn?
options: Always write down what people promise.
Winter is the best time to move.
questions.explanation: Автор радить завжди записувати те, що обіцяють люди, бо вікно довго лишалося несправним.
